import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        double x = sc.nextDouble();
        double y = sc.nextDouble();
        int n = sc.nextInt();

        double minDiff = Double.MAX_VALUE;
        long bestNum = 0;
        long bestDen = 1;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            double val = (x * i) / y;
            long floorVal = (long) Math.floor(val);
            double diffFloor = Math.abs((x / y) - ((double) floorVal / i));
            if (diffFloor < minDiff) {
                minDiff = diffFloor;
                bestNum = floorVal;
                bestDen = i;
            }
            long ceilVal = (long) Math.ceil(val);
            double diffCeil = Math.abs((x / y) - ((double) ceilVal / i));
            if (diffCeil < minDiff) {
                minDiff = diffCeil;
                bestNum = ceilVal;
                bestDen = i;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(bestNum + "/" + bestDen);
        sc.close();
    }
}
